title: Memebae
tagline: Use telegram bots to create Linear.app issues to help speed up development
description:
We've built an issue creator Telegram bot to allow us to create new linear /issues via telegram bot.

This helps us to streamline development tasks going forward.

Work is done in python and graphql and uses the linear api keys to seamlessly integrate linear and telegram. This will help create issues from bugs much faster. Helping to speed up development.
how_its_made: we've used the telegram bot basic library in python3 . We've built the connections. that only needs to link TG user and linear username to get it working. Under the hood we're using the linear graphql api and requests to ship post requests to the api and Telegram bot and /botfather to make it work on telegram side.
